title: Send project messages
responsibility: Sends questions, plans, code requests and human comments while keeping conversation text with its project.

inputs.name: projectAgentActions.agent
inputs.description: The current project conversation and the bridge allowed to send its requests.

inputs.name: projectAgentActions.draft
inputs.description: The selected Plan, Ask or Change mode, the message and the exact discovered model.

inputs.name: projectAgentComment.agent
inputs.description: The conversation and verified comment permission of the selected project.

inputs.name: projectAgentComment.text
inputs.description: Human comment to save at the entity or project revision currently in view.

outputs.name: projectAgentActions
outputs.description: True when a request completes or leaves a saved plan holding its request; false when refused, cancelled or failed.

outputs.name: projectAgentComment
outputs.description: True after saving the human comment; false if permission or saving fails.
